title: 1 · Tâi-lô consonants: p and ph, ts and tsh, and the voiced b, g, j
blurb: Read the consonants of Tâi-lô correctly, including the ones that look English but are not.

title: 2 · Vowels and endings: o and oo, nasal nn, and the stops -p -t -k -h
blurb: Read Taigi vowels and syllable endings: o against oo, nasal vowels, and the short stopped endings.

title: 3 · The seven tones and their marks
blurb: Name the tone of any marked Tâi-lô syllable and describe how it sounds.

title: 4 · Tone sandhi 1: every syllable but the last changes
blurb: Say which tone the first syllable of a two-syllable word takes in speech, while the spelling stays the same.

title: 5 · Tone sandhi 2: checked syllables, 仔, and the neutral tone after --
blurb: Handle sandhi on short checked syllables and read the light neutral-tone syllable after --.

title: 6 · Greetings: 𠢕早, 食飽未？, 多謝, 歹勢, 再會
blurb: Greet people the way Taiwanese families do, thank them, apologize and say goodbye.

title: 7 · Reading Taigi characters: 毋, 佇, 遮, 欲, 予
blurb: Recognize the characters Taigi uses for its own words, and avoid the Mandarin look-alikes.

title: 8 · Classroom phrases: 請閣講一擺, 慢慢仔講
blurb: Ask a teacher to repeat or slow down, and say that you don't know.

title: 9 · 是 and 毋是; 我, 你, 伊, and two words for we: 阮 and 咱
blurb: Say who someone is with 是 and 毋是, and use the right pronoun, including the two words for we.

title: 10 · Introducing yourself: 你號做啥物名？ 我是學生
blurb: Say your name and surname, what you do and where you live, and ask the same of someone you meet.

title: 11 · Question words: 啥物, 啥人, 佗位, 當時, 按怎
blurb: Ask what, who, where, when, how and how much, and bounce a question back with 你咧？

title: 12 · Two sets of numbers: counting, and reading digits
blurb: Count from one to ten thousand, say two of something with 兩, and read out a phone number.

title: 13 · Family: 阿爸, 阿母, 阿公, 阿媽, 阿兄
blurb: Name the people in your family, and say my, your and his the way Taigi does with family words.

title: 14 · 有 and 無: have, there is, and questions with 無 and 敢
blurb: Say what you have and what there is, say you don't have it, and ask yes/no questions with 無 and 敢.

title: 15 · Classifiers: 一个人, 兩本冊, 三碗飯; 這 and 彼
blurb: Count people and things with the right classifier, and point at them with 這 (this) and 彼 (that).

title: 16 · Money and prices: 偌濟錢？, 箍, 傷貴
blurb: Ask how much something costs, understand prices in 箍, and say that something is cheap or too expensive.

title: 17 · Want and need: 欲, 愛, 想欲
blurb: Say what you want to do, what you like, what you would like and what you don't want.

title: 18 · Where things are: 佇, 遮 and 遐, 頂懸, 下跤
blurb: Say where people and things are, and where you do things, with 佇 and the place words.

title: 19 · Directions: 正手, 倒手, 直直行, 斡
blurb: Ask where something is and follow simple directions: go straight, turn right or left at the intersection.

title: 20 · Going and coming: 去, 來, 坐車, 捷運
blurb: Say where you are going and how: by MRT, train, high-speed rail, taxi or on foot, and where you get off.

title: 21 · Time and days: 幾點？, 今仔日, 禮拜日
blurb: Ask and tell the time, name today, tomorrow and yesterday, the parts of the day and some days of the week, and put them in the right place.

title: 22 · At the night market: 頭家, 一碗麵, 好食
blurb: Order at a night-market stall by the bowl or the cup, name the classic dishes, and say whether the food is good.

title: 23 · At the market: 菜, 肉, 卵, 魚, and asking how much
blurb: Shop at the morning market: name vegetables, meat, fish, eggs and fruit, ask the price by weight, and say cheap or expensive.

title: 24 · Describing and comparing: 真, 誠, 足; 比…較, 上
blurb: Describe things with very, too and most, and compare two things with 比…較, never with 是.

title: 25 · Can and may: 會 and 袂, 會使, 會曉
blurb: Say what will or won't happen, what you know how to do, what is allowed and what you are able to do, each with its own pair of words.

title: 26 · Four words for not: 毋, 無, 袂, 莫
blurb: Choose the right 'not' every time: 毋, 無, 袂, 莫 and 免, side by side.

title: 27 · Actions in time: 咧 (in progress), 矣 (done), 有…過 (ever)
blurb: Say that something is going on now, that something has changed, that you have ever done something, and that you haven't yet.
